verdict.rationale: Browserbase supports scheduled/on-demand agent deployment and continuous monitoring use cases (e.g., alerting on breakage, tracking price/job changes), which implies some event-triggered automation, but there's no documented rule-engine or explicit event-trigger/webhook-condition system for defining 'if X happens, do Y' automation. missing for 10: explicit rule-definition interface, event-trigger/webhook configuration docs, condition-action automation examples, independent verification of trigger-based workflows.
